requirements.description: The system shall provide an e-commerce platform allowing customers to browse and purchase clothes online, including seasonal collections (winter, summer, and rainy season wear).

requirements.title: The website shall segment clothing catalogs by target demogr
requirements.description: The website shall segment clothing catalogs by target demographics: Children & Teenagers (ages 0–18, boys and girls) and Young Adults (ages 18–30).

requirements.title: The application shall prompt the user to sign in with their
requirements.description: The application shall prompt the user to sign in with their Google account when they attempt to like/favorite a product or initiate a checkout purchase.

requirements.title: The home screen and product catalog pages shall be publicly
requirements.description: The home screen and product catalog pages shall be publicly accessible without requiring user authentication. Guest users can freely view products.
